what: CONSORT-style inclusion/exclusion cascade for the ROP staging corpus. Every layer recomputed from committed artifacts; the script refuses to emit a flow whose exclusion reasons do not sum to the observed drop.

layer_0_acquired.note: public research datasets plus one private hospital corpus (Ostrava). Excludes the _redundant quarantine (re-uploads and mirrors of sources already counted).

reasons.farfum_rop: plus/pre-plus grades only — no ICROP stage
reasons.hvdropdb: ridge segmentation masks — no stage label
reasons.ropstages_sample: sample too small to fold (91 images) and provenance unverified
reasons.shenzhen_duplicates_of_ropvl: perceptual-hash duplicates: the same photographs re-encoded at lower resolution; the ROP-VL copy is kept

reasons.other_pathology: not ROP — hemorrhage, toxoplasma, hamartoma, optic-nerve hypoplasia; these are the 43% of the binary corpus's 'ROP-positive' that is not ROP
reasons.treated: st.p. ROP (status post — treated or regressed). Post-treatment appearance is not an ICROP stage; including it would teach the model to call treated eyes diseased at whatever stage they once were
reasons.stage_0: ICROP stage 0 is immature retina WITHOUT ROP — it belongs with normal or nowhere, and at 45 images cannot support its own class

layer_3_analysis_sets.note: multiview_locked has never been opened. multiview_dev is the only held-out set inspected during development; the CV pool is split patient-grouped into 5 folds plus a leave-Shenzhen-out site fold.

layer_4_frame_caps_in_cv_pool.rule: at most 20 frames per infant per class, and at most 2 normal frames per infant. Ostrava images every infant repeatedly in one session, so without a cap a handful of infants would supply most of the gradient.
layer_4_frame_caps_in_cv_pool.note: Capped frames are excluded from TRAINING only. Validation scores every eligible image in the fold, which is why AP-ROP validation is dominated by one heavily-imaged infant even though training is not.

headline: 13037 images acquired -> 10427 with ICROP stage labels -> 8024 eligible for the 6-class task (1760 infants) -> 3112 used for training after per-infant frame caps.
